name: acceptance-and-traceability
title: Acceptance and Traceability
description: Connect requirements to applicable results and acceptance decisions. Use when defining done, checking coverage or assessing the evidence impact of a change.
focus: Connect requirements to executed evidence and acceptance
frameworks: Requirements traceability matrix; verification versus validation

name: benefits-realization
title: Benefits Realization
description: Define and verify benefits after project delivery. Use when outputs need to be connected to owned, measurable business outcomes and review decisions.
focus: Assign and verify post-delivery business outcomes
frameworks: Benefits map; leading/lagging measures; ownership and review plan

name: change-request
title: Change Request
description: Assess a proposed change and preserve exact approval boundaries. Use when scope, date, cost or acceptance changes cross agreed project control limits.
focus: Assess and decide changes without laundering baselines
frameworks: Integrated change control; impact analysis; configuration history

name: communication-plan
title: Communication Plan
description: Plan project communications around decisions, evidence and feedback. Use when updates are missed, audiences need different detail or meetings fail to resolve work.
focus: Choose audience-specific messages, channels, and feedback
frameworks: Communication matrix; push/pull/interactive communication

name: decision-log
title: Decision Log
description: Record the exact choice, authority, rationale and conditions. Use when project decisions need traceable history across meetings, changes or conflicting recollections.
focus: Preserve the exact choice, authority, rationale and conditions
frameworks: DACI; decision records; option analysis

name: delivery-approach-advisor
title: Delivery Approach Advisor
description: Choose and tailor predictive, agile or hybrid practices. Use when uncertainty, feedback, dependencies and governance need to fit one delivery approach.
focus: Choose delivery practices that fit uncertainty and governance
frameworks: Predictive/agile/hybrid tailoring; rolling-wave planning

name: delivery-control-cycle
title: Delivery Control Cycle
description: Reconcile project evidence and turn exceptions into decisions. Use for a recurring control review or material change in delivery, funding or readiness.
focus: Run a repeatable evidence-to-decision control review
frameworks: Plan-monitor-control; exception escalation; integrated change control

name: dependency-map
title: Dependency Map
description: Define cross-team handoffs, usable acceptance and timing gaps. Use when external deliverables, approvals or shared services may block project work.
focus: Secure usable provider-to-receiver handoffs
frameworks: Dependency network; interface agreements; local margin versus float

name: escalation-brief
title: Escalation Brief
description: Present evidence, options and a precise decision request. Use when a project consequence exceeds delegated authority or a time-critical exception needs intervention.
focus: Obtain a timely decision beyond delegated authority
frameworks: SBAR; options and recommendation; last responsible decision point

name: estimation-advisor
title: Estimation Advisor
description: Choose and explain an estimation method with units, assumptions and uncertainty. Use when sizing work or testing a forecast before committing effort or dates.
focus: Select an estimation method and expose uncertainty
frameworks: Analogous/parametric/bottom-up estimation; three-point PERT; empirical forecasting

name: gantt-chart
title: Gantt Chart
description: Create a dated Gantt chart with dependencies and baseline comparison. Use when a project schedule needs a readable timeline for planning or control.
focus: Show dated work, dependencies, baselines, and milestones
frameworks: Gantt timeline; working calendars; baseline/forecast comparison

name: integrated-project-planning
title: Integrated Project Planning
description: Reconcile scope, acceptance, schedule, capacity, costs and controls into one plan. Use when preparing a baseline or revising a plan whose parts no longer agree.
focus: Reconcile scope, schedule, capacity, funding and gates
frameworks: Integrated baseline planning; progressive elaboration; consistency review

name: lessons-learned
title: Lessons Learned
description: Capture reusable learning with evidence, context and limits. Use when a milestone, experiment or project outcome should inform another team or future delivery.
focus: Capture transferable learning with limits and adoption evidence
frameworks: After-action review; contextual lessons; knowledge transfer

name: meeting-knowledge-graph
title: Meeting Knowledge Graph
description: Build evidence-linked OKF meeting memory. Use when transcripts or notes need durable decisions, actions and recurring-series history rather than only a brief summary.
focus: Preserve evidence-linked meeting history and current state
frameworks: OKF v0.2; immutable ledgers; attribution confidence; series delta

name: milestone-schedule
title: Milestone Schedule
description: Build and analyze dependency logic, float and milestone forecasts. Use when testing schedule feasibility or the effect of a duration or dependency change.
focus: Build feasible logic and milestone forecasts
frameworks: Critical Path Method; total float; rolling-wave scheduling

name: organizational-change
title: Organizational Change and Adoption
description: Prepare affected people to adopt new ways of working. Use when project delivery changes roles, processes or services and training alone will not establish readiness.
focus: Prepare affected people to adopt the delivered change
frameworks: ADKAR lens; change impact assessment; readiness and reinforcement

name: prioritization-advisor
title: Prioritization Advisor
description: Choose a scope prioritization method that fits evidence and constraints. Use when optional project work competes for limited time, funding or capacity.
focus: Choose a defensible scope sequencing or tradeoff method
frameworks: MoSCoW; RICE; weighted scoring; Cost of Delay; Kano

name: project-budget
title: Project Budget
description: Build and review cost baselines, actuals, remaining forecasts and funding gaps. Use when planning a budget or explaining project cost performance and reserve decisions.
focus: Plan and control forecast cost and funding
frameworks: Cost baseline; contingency versus management reserve; earned value management

name: project-business-case
title: Project Business Case
description: Compare project options, costs, benefits and uncertainty. Use when an investment or material continuation decision needs a defensible business case.
focus: Compare investment options before authorizing delivery
frameworks: Options appraisal; cost-benefit analysis; sensitivity analysis

name: project-charter
title: Project Charter
description: Define the project mandate, boundaries, success and authority. Use when starting a project or clarifying what delivery is authorized to achieve.
focus: Authorize a bounded outcome and management mandate
frameworks: Project charter; SMART success criteria; assumption analysis

name: project-closure
title: Project Closure
description: Reconcile delivery, finances and continuing obligations. Use when preparing normal project closure or authorized termination with explicit acceptance and ownership.
focus: Close or terminate only with accepted residual obligations
frameworks: Closure assurance; financial reconciliation; residual transfer; benefits handoff

name: project-governance
title: Project Governance
description: Define project decision rights, tolerances and evidence gates. Use when approval, escalation or acceptance responsibilities are unclear.
focus: Define decision rights, tolerances, assurance, and escalation
frameworks: Stage gates; management by exception; delegated authority

name: project-health-diagnostic
title: Project Health Diagnostic
description: Diagnose delivery health and evidence confidence. Use when project status is disputed, incomplete or contradicted by cost, schedule or acceptance evidence.
focus: Diagnose delivery confidence from conflicting signals
frameworks: Dimensional health assessment; leading/lagging indicators; causal hypotheses

name: project-intake-advisor
title: Project Intake Advisor
description: Triage an incoming request into a project, change, operational task or investigation. Use when a vague ask or escalation needs a response before commitment.
focus: Triage requests into a project, change, operational work, or investigation
frameworks: Request triage; outcome-evidence-action; decision rights

name: project-kickoff
title: Project Kickoff
description: Establish mandate, decision rights and a usable working agreement. Use when starting or resetting a software or IT project.
focus: Turn the mandate into an operating agreement
frameworks: Kickoff facilitation; RACI; decision/action separation

name: project-recovery-advisor
title: Project Recovery Advisor
description: Choose a credible response when the delivery plan fails. Use after a material project setback or diagnosis, with causal evidence, options and measurable checkpoints.
focus: Select a feasible response when the plan fails
frameworks: Root-cause hypotheses; recovery option appraisal; recovery checkpoints

name: quality-management-plan
title: Quality Management Plan
description: Define quality criteria, prevention, verification and defect control. Use when project quality expectations need an executable plan before delivery or release.
focus: Plan assurance, verification and defect disposition
frameworks: Quality planning/assurance/control; verification versus validation; risk-based testing; PDCA

name: raci-matrix
title: RACI Matrix
description: Build and audit a responsibility assignment matrix. Use when work ownership, accountability, consultation, or notification is unclear.
focus: Assign clear work accountability without inventing authority
frameworks: RACI responsibility assignment matrix; horizontal/vertical role analysis

name: raid-log
title: RAID Log
description: Maintain distinct risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies with evidence and closure rules. Use when setting up controls or updating them after new project evidence.
focus: Maintain actionable risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies
frameworks: RAID; cause-event-effect; issue lifecycle; assumption validation

name: release-and-handover
title: Release and Handover
description: Plan and coordinate authorized release, stabilization and service transfer. Use for software launches or IT cutovers with explicit recovery and ownership boundaries.
focus: Coordinate authorized execution and accepted service transfer
frameworks: Cutover checkpoints; recovery limits; service transition; hypercare exit

name: release-readiness
title: Release Readiness
description: Assess a defined release against current gate evidence. Use before a pilot, launch or migration cutover to recommend go or hold without inventing authorization.
focus: Recommend go/hold using current applicable evidence
frameworks: Readiness gates; exception authority; operational acceptance

name: resource-capacity-plan
title: Resource Capacity Plan
description: Compare complete demand with realistic availability, skills and timing. Use when staffing, competing assignments or a shared specialist may make a plan infeasible.
focus: Resolve individual bottlenecks and competing allocations
frameworks: Capacity-demand analysis; skill constraints; resource leveling options

name: retrospective
title: Retrospective
description: Turn delivery observations into a few testable improvements. Use after an iteration, rehearsal or milestone when the team needs evidence-based learning and follow-through.
focus: Turn observations into testable improvements
frameworks: PDCA; 5 Whys with evidence; experiment design

name: risk-workshop
title: Risk Workshop
description: Facilitate a focused risk review and choose owned responses. Use before a commitment, after a material change or when uncertainty is hidden by a stale register.
focus: Discover and select responses to project uncertainty
frameworks: Premortem; probability-impact matrix; response planning; residual risk

name: scope-and-wbs
title: Scope and Work Breakdown
description: Define a deliverable-oriented scope breakdown with boundaries and completion evidence. Use when preparing estimates or resolving missing, duplicated or expanding project work.
focus: Decompose complete deliverables and control boundaries
frameworks: Deliverable-oriented WBS; 100% rule; WBS dictionary

name: sprint-planning
title: Sprint Planning
description: Prepare a coherent Sprint Goal and feasible team forecast. Use when supporting Scrum Sprint Planning with capacity, dependencies and required quality made explicit.
focus: Support a coherent goal and feasible team forecast
frameworks: Scrum Sprint Planning; Sprint Goal; Definition of Done; capacity

name: stakeholder-engagement-advisor
title: Stakeholder Engagement Advisor
description: Plan engagement for a specific stakeholder. Use when preparing an outreach, navigating resistance, or aligning a critical relationship before a key milestone.
focus: Prepare reciprocal engagement for a specific stakeholder
frameworks: Adaptive Decision Ladder; MITRE engagement canvas; credible proxies

name: stakeholder-identification
title: Stakeholder Identification
description: Identify affected people and decision makers before prioritizing engagement. Use when starting a project or checking a stakeholder list for missing voices.
focus: Find affected people, delivery partners, and decision makers
frameworks: MITRE stakeholder identification; allies/audiences/influencers; equity lens

name: stakeholder-map
title: Stakeholder Map
description: Prioritize stakeholders using two complementary grids. Use when setting engagement strategy and surfacing whose voice needs elevating after stakeholder identification.
focus: Set engagement priorities and expose missing voices
frameworks: Power-interest matrix; impact-power matrix; quadrant migration

name: status-report
title: Status Report
description: Report project evidence, forecast variance and decisions needed. Use for an executive update, recurring control report or material exception.
focus: Report evidence, variance and decisions for the audience
frameworks: RAG by tolerance; management by exception; baseline/forecast/actual

name: vendor-procurement
title: Vendor and Procurement Management
description: Plan supplier selection, acceptance and delivery control. Use when a project depends on purchased services or vendor deliverables.
focus: Define vendor selection, deliverables, acceptance and controls
frameworks: Make-or-buy; weighted supplier evaluation; contract deliverable control

name: workshop-facilitation
title: Workshop Facilitation
description: Facilitate workshop sessions in a one-step, multi-turn flow. Use when an interactive skill needs consistent pacing, options, and progress tracking.
focus: Run purposeful guided sessions and handle interruptions
frameworks: One-question facilitation; guided/context-dump/best-guess modes
